notes.title: Paradox Publisher Event - King Arthur Day
notes.notes:
Now through Sunday take advantage of great Daily Deals on Paradox titles or save huge on The Paradox Complete Collection, which contains over 90 games and DLC for one low price!

Today's Daily Deal is King Arthur and the King Arthur Collection for 75% off!

Additionally, King Arthur: Fallen Champions has just been released on Steam! This standalone expansion to the hit RPG introduces three unique heroes to command through an all new campaign.

Daily Deal offer ends Saturday at 10AM Pacific Time.
